description: This file defines custom error classes, a data model for error responses, and an exception handler for FastAPI to provide consistent error responses for API failures.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Structured error response model used for API failure responses.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: Base exception class for API-related errors.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Exception indicating a requested resource was not found.

classes.name: ConflictError
classes.description: Exception indicating a conflict, such as a uniqueness violation.

classes.name: DatabaseError
classes.description: Exception indicating an unexpected database failure.

methods.name: JSONResponse api_error_handler(_: Request, exc: ApiError)
methods.description: FastAPI exception handler that converts ApiError exceptions into JSONResponse objects with a standardized error format.
